name: TDV
stmt: def TDV (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (V : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: fun s => r s + γ * V (next s)

name: TDUpdate
stmt: def TDUpdate (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ) (V : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: fun s => V s + α * (r s + γ * V (next s) - V s)

name: td_operator_affine
stmt:
theorem td_operator_affine (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (V : Fin n → ℝ) :
    TDUpdate next r γ α V
      = fun s => (1 - α) * V s + α * (r s + γ * V (next s))
proof:
by
  funext s
  unfold TDUpdate
  ring

name: td_contraction_norm
stmt:
theorem td_contraction_norm (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (_hγ1 : γ < 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (V W : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ‖TDUpdate next r γ α V - TDUpdate next r γ α W‖
      ≤ (1 - α + α * γ) * ‖V - W‖
proof:
by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 1 - α + α * γ := by nlinarith [hα1, hγ0, hα0.le]
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc0 (norm_nonneg (V - W)))).2 ?_
  intro s
                                                     
  have hD : (TDUpdate next r γ α V - TDUpdate next r γ α W) s
      = (1 - α) * (V s - W s) + (α * γ) * (V (next s) - W (next s)) := by
    show TDUpdate next r γ α V s - TDUpdate next r γ α W s = _
    unfold TDUpdate
    ring
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hD]
                         
  have h1 : |V s - W s| ≤ ‖V - W‖ := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm (V - W) s
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  have h2 : |V (next s) - W (next s)| ≤ ‖V - W‖ := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm (V - W) (next s)
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  calc
    |(1 - α) * (V s - W s) + (α * γ) * (V (next s) - W (next s))|
        ≤ |(1 - α) * (V s - W s)| + |(α * γ) * (V (next s) - W (next s))| := abs_add _ _
    _ = (1 - α) * |V s - W s| + (α * γ) * |V (next s) - W (next s)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - α),
            abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα0.le hγ0)]
    _ ≤ (1 - α) * ‖V - W‖ + (α * γ) * ‖V - W‖ := by
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (mul_nonneg hα0.le hγ0))
    _ = (1 - α + α * γ) * ‖V - W‖ := by ring

name: td_contraction
stmt:
theorem td_contraction (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (V W : Fin n → ℝ) :
    LinfNorm (fun s => TDUpdate next r γ α V s - TDUpdate next r γ α W s)
      ≤ (1 - α + α * γ) * LinfNorm (fun s => V s - W s)
proof:
by
                                                        
  rw [linfNorm_eq_norm, linfNorm_eq_norm]
  simpa using td_contraction_norm next r γ α hγ0 hγ1 hα0 hα1 V W

name: td_converges
stmt:
theorem td_converges (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (V₀ V₁ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t : ℕ,
      LinfNorm (fun s => ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₁ s
        - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₀ s) < ε
proof:
by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 1 - α + α * γ := by nlinarith [hα1, hγ0, hα0.le]
  have hc1 : 1 - α + α * γ < 1 := by nlinarith [hα0, hγ1]
  let e : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => LinfNorm (fun s => ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₁ s
      - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₀ s)
  have hnonneg : ∀ t : ℕ, 0 ≤ e t := by intro t; dsimp only [e]; exact linfNorm_nonneg _
  have hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, e (t + 1) ≤ (1 - α + α * γ) * e t := by
    intro t
                                                       
    have h := td_contraction next r γ α hγ0 hγ1 hα0 hα1
      (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₁)
      (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => TDUpdate next r γ α) t V₀)
    dsimp only [e]
    simpa [ChainFwd] using h
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := contraction_converges (1 - α + α * γ) hc0 hc1 hstep hnonneg ε hε
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: td_contracting
stmt:
theorem td_contracting (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    ContractingWith ⟨1 - α + α * γ, by nlinarith [hα1, hγ0, hα0.le]⟩
      (TDUpdate next r γ α)
proof:
by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 1 - α + α * γ := by nlinarith [hα1, hγ0, hα0.le]
  have hc1 : 1 - α + α * γ < 1 := by nlinarith [hα0, hγ1]
  constructor
  · simpa using hc1
  · rw [LipschitzWith]
    intro V W
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist]
    rw [ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq (⟨1 - α + α * γ, hc0⟩ : NNReal)]
    simp
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc0]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (td_contraction_norm next r γ α hγ0 hγ1 hα0 hα1 V W)

name: td_fixed_point_exists
stmt:
theorem td_fixed_point_exists (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (V₀ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ Vstar : Fin n → ℝ, TDUpdate next r γ α Vstar = Vstar
proof:
by
  have hc := td_contracting next r γ α hγ0 hγ1 hα0 hα1
  have hfinite : edist V₀ (TDUpdate next r γ α V₀) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [edist_dist]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  rcases (ContractingWith.exists_fixedPoint hc V₀ hfinite) with ⟨Vstar, hfix, _, _⟩
  exact ⟨Vstar, hfix⟩

name: td_fixed_point_is_value
stmt:
theorem td_fixed_point_is_value (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hα : α ≠ 0) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (hfix : TDUpdate next r γ α V = V) (s : Fin n) :
    r s + γ * V (next s) = V s
proof:
by
  have h := congr_fun hfix s
  have hzero : α * (r s + γ * V (next s) - V s) = 0 := by
    unfold TDUpdate at h
    linarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 hα
  · linarith

name: td_fixed_point_eq_bellman
stmt:
theorem td_fixed_point_eq_bellman (next : Fin n → Fin n) (r : Fin n → ℝ) (γ α : ℝ)
    (hα : α ≠ 0) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (hfix : TDUpdate next r γ α V = V) :
    TDV next r γ V = V
proof:
by
  funext s
  exact td_fixed_point_is_value next r γ α hα V hfix s

                 
                                         
                                               
                                                       
                                      
                                 
                                                      

end Lattice

name: monotone_finite_sequence_stabilizes
stmt:
theorem monotone_finite_sequence_stabilizes {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (S : ℕ → Set α)
    (hmono : ∀ k : ℕ, S k ⊆ S (k + 1)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, S N = S (N + 1)
proof:
by
  by_contra hnot
                          
  have hne : ∀ k : ℕ, S k ≠ S (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    intro h
    exact hnot ⟨k, h⟩
                                
  have hss : ∀ k : ℕ, S k ⊂ S (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne).2 ⟨hmono k, hne k⟩
                                      
  have hcard : ∀ k : ℕ, (S k).ncard < (S (k + 1)).ncard := by
    intro k
    exact Set.ncard_lt_ncard (hss k)
                      
  have hbound : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ (S k).ncard := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact zero_le _
    | succ k ih =>
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt ih (hcard k))
                                                     
  have hbig : Fintype.card α + 1 ≤ (S (Fintype.card α + 1)).ncard :=
    hbound (Fintype.card α + 1)
  have hsmall : (S (Fintype.card α + 1)).ncard ≤ Fintype.card α := by
    calc
      (S (Fintype.card α + 1)).ncard ≤ (Set.univ : Set α).ncard :=
        Set.ncard_le_ncard (by exact Set.subset_univ _)
      _ = Fintype.card α := by
        rw [Set.ncard_univ]
        exact Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
  have hcon : Fintype.card α + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α := le_trans hbig hsmall
  exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self (Fintype.card α)) hcon

name: union_le_stabilized
stmt:
theorem union_le_stabilized {α : Type*} (S : ℕ → Set α) (N : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → S k ⊆ S N) :
    (⋃ k ∈ {k : ℕ | k ≤ N}, S k) = S N
proof:
by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    simp at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩
    exact h k hk hxk
  · intro hx
    simpa using (⟨N, le_rfl, hx⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, k ≤ N ∧ x ∈ S k)

name: roundtrip_bijective
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_bijective {X Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X)
    (h₁ : ∀ x : X, g (f x) = x) (h₂ : ∀ y : Y, f (g y) = y) :
    Function.Bijective f
proof:
by
  constructor
  ·                                    
    intro x₁ x₂ h
    calc
      x₁ = g (f x₁) := (h₁ x₁).symm
      _ = g (f x₂) := by rw [h]
      _ = x₂ := h₁ x₂
  ·                             
    intro y
    exact ⟨g y, h₂ y⟩

name: bijective_iff_inverse
stmt:
theorem bijective_iff_inverse {X Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) :
    Function.Bijective f ↔ ∃ g : Y → X, (∀ x : X, g (f x) = x) ∧ (∀ y : Y, f (g y) = y)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hf
                                       
    rcases (Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mp hf) with ⟨g, hg₁, hg₂⟩
    exact ⟨g, hg₁, hg₂⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨g, hg₁, hg₂⟩
    exact roundtrip_bijective f g hg₁ hg₂

name: ratio_norm_contracts_x
stmt:
theorem ratio_norm_contracts_x {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x x' y : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx' : 0 ≤ x') (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y + ε)| ≤ (1 / ε) * |x - x'|
proof:
by
  have hden1 : 0 < x + y + ε := by nlinarith
  have hden2 : 0 < x' + y + ε := by nlinarith
                                         
  have hcalc : x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y + ε)
      = (x - x') * (y + ε) / ((x + y + ε) * (x' + y + ε)) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hden1, ne_of_gt hden2]
    ring
  rw [hcalc]
                        
  have hD : (x + y + ε) * (x' + y + ε) ≥ (y + ε) * (y + ε) := by
    have h₁ : x + y + ε ≥ y + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₂ : x' + y + ε ≥ y + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ y + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x + y + ε := by nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  have hpos : 0 < (x + y + ε) * (x' + y + ε) := mul_pos hden1 hden2
  have hyepos : 0 < y + ε := by nlinarith
  have hdenpos : 0 < (y + ε) * (y + ε) := mul_pos hyepos hyepos
  calc
    |(x - x') * (y + ε) / ((x + y + ε) * (x' + y + ε))|
        = |x - x'| * (y + ε) / ((x + y + ε) * (x' + y + ε)) := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_mul]
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ y + ε)]
          rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
    _ ≤ |x - x'| * (y + ε) / ((y + ε) * (y + ε)) := by
                                      
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ y + ε)) hdenpos hD
    _ = |x - x'| * ((y + ε) / ((y + ε) * (y + ε))) := by ring
    _ = |x - x'| * (1 / (y + ε)) := by
          have hye : y + ε ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
          congr 1
          field_simp [hye]
    _ ≤ |x - x'| * (1 / ε) := by

name: ratio_norm_contracts_y
stmt:
theorem ratio_norm_contracts_y {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x y y' : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : 0 ≤ y') :
    |x / (x + y + ε) - x / (x + y' + ε)| ≤ (1 / (4 * ε)) * |y - y'|
proof:
by
  have hden1 : 0 < x + y + ε := by nlinarith
  have hden2 : 0 < x + y' + ε := by nlinarith
                                     
  have hcalc : x / (x + y + ε) - x / (x + y' + ε)
      = x * (y' - y) / ((x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε)) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hden1, ne_of_gt hden2]
    ring
  rw [hcalc]
                        
  have hD : (x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε) ≥ (x + ε) * (x + ε) := by
    have h₁ : x + y + ε ≥ x + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₂ : x + y' + ε ≥ x + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ x + ε := by nlinarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ x + y + ε := by nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  have hpos : 0 < (x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε) := mul_pos hden1 hden2
  have hxepos : 0 < x + ε := by nlinarith
  have hdenpos : 0 < (x + ε) * (x + ε) := mul_pos hxepos hxepos
                                                
  have hquartic : x / (x + ε) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (4 * ε) := by
    have hxle : 4 * ε * x ≤ (x + ε) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - ε)]
    have hden4 : 0 < 4 * ε := by nlinarith
    have hdenx : 0 < (x + ε) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hdenx hden4]
    nlinarith [hxle]
  calc
    |x * (y' - y) / ((x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε))|
        = |x| * |y' - y| / ((x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε)) := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_mul]
          rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
    _ = x * |y' - y| / ((x + y + ε) * (x + y' + ε)) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
    _ ≤ x * |y' - y| / ((x + ε) * (x + ε)) := by
                                      
          exact d

name: ratio_norm_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem ratio_norm_lipschitz {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x x' y y' : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx' : 0 ≤ x') (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy' : 0 ≤ y') :
    |x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y' + ε)| ≤ (1 / ε) * (|x - x'| + |y - y'|)
proof:
by
                      
  calc
    |x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y' + ε)|
        = |(x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y + ε))
            + (x' / (x' + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y' + ε))| := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ ≤ |x / (x + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y + ε)|
        + |x' / (x' + y + ε) - x' / (x' + y' + ε)| :=
          abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / ε) * |x - x'| + (1 / (4 * ε)) * |y - y'| := by
          exact add_le_add (ratio_norm_contracts_x hε x x' y hx hx' hy)
            (ratio_norm_contracts_y hε x' y y' hx' hy hy')
    _ ≤ (1 / ε) * |x - x'| + (1 / ε) * |y - y'| := by
                         
          have hle : 1 / (4 * ε) ≤ 1 / ε := by
            exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hε (by nlinarith : ε ≤ 4 * ε)
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (abs_nonneg _)) _
    _ = (1 / ε) * (|x - x'| + |y - y'|) := by ring

                      
                               
                              
                              
                                        
                                        
                                       
                      

end Lattice

name: LinfNorm
stmt: def LinfNorm (V : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ s : Fin n, x = |V s|}

name: bddAbove_abs
stmt: lemma bddAbove_abs (V : Fin n → ℝ) : BddAbove {x : ℝ | ∃ s : Fin n, x = |V s|}
proof:
by
  convert (Set.Finite.bddAbove (Set.finite_range (fun s : Fin n => |V s|)) :
      BddAbove (Set.range (fun s : Fin n => |V s|))) using 1
  ext x
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨s, rfl⟩

name: linfNorm_abs
stmt: lemma linfNorm_abs (V : Fin n → ℝ) : LinfNorm (fun s => |V s|) = LinfNorm V
proof:
by
  unfold LinfNorm
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨s, by rw [abs_abs]⟩

name: linfNorm_nonneg
stmt: lemma linfNorm_nonneg (V : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ LinfNorm V
proof:
by
  unfold LinfNorm
  by_cases h : Nonempty (Fin n)
  · rcases h with ⟨s⟩
    exact le_trans (abs_nonneg (V s)) (le_csSup (bddAbove_abs V) (by exact ⟨s, rfl⟩))
  · have h0 : {x : ℝ | ∃ s : Fin n, x = |V s|} = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨s, _⟩
      exact h ⟨s⟩
    rw [h0, Real.sSup_empty]

name: BellmanOp
stmt: def BellmanOp (P : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (V : Fin n → ℝ) (s : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: R s + γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * V s')

name: bellman_contraction
stmt:
theorem bellman_contraction (P : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hPnonneg : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ P s s')
    (hPsum : ∀ s, (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s') = 1)
    (V V' : Fin n → ℝ) :
    LinfNorm (fun s => γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * (V s' - V' s')))
      ≤ γ * LinfNorm (fun s => |V s - V' s|)
proof:
by
                                                            
  rw [linfNorm_abs (fun s => V s - V' s)]
  unfold LinfNorm
  by_cases hne : Nonempty (Fin n)
  ·                                                            
    apply csSup_le
    · rcases hne with ⟨s0⟩
      exact ⟨|γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s0 s' * (V s' - V' s'))|, ⟨s0, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨s, rfl⟩
      calc
        |γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * (V s' - V' s'))|
            = γ * |∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * (V s' - V' s')| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hγ0]
        _ ≤ γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, |P s s' * (V s' - V' s')|) := by
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (fun s' => P s s' * (V s' - V' s')) Finset.univ) hγ0
        _ ≤ γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ s, x = |V s - V' s|}) := by
              have hstep : ∀ s' : Fin n, s' ∈ Finset.univ →
                  |P s s' * (V s' - V' s')| ≤ P s s' * sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ s, x = |V s - V' s|} := by
                intro s' hs'
                calc
                  |P s s' * (V s' - V' s')| ≤ P s s' * |V s' - V' s'| := by
                        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hPnonneg s s')]
                  _ ≤ P s s' * sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ s, x = |V s - V' s|} := by
                        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                          (le_csSup (bddAbove_abs (fun s => V s - V' s)) (by exact ⟨s', rfl⟩))
                          (hPnonneg s s')
              exact mul_le_mu

name: value_iteration_contraction
stmt:
theorem value_iteration_contraction (P : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (_hγ1 : γ < 1) (hPnonneg : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ P s s')
    (hPsum : ∀ s, (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s') = 1) (V₀ V₁ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, LinfNorm (fun s => ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁ s
        - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀ s)
      ≤ γ ^ t * LinfNorm (fun s => V₁ s - V₀ s)
proof:
by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
      simp [ChainFwd]
  | succ t ih =>
      calc
        LinfNorm (fun s => ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) (t + 1) V₁ s
            - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) (t + 1) V₀ s)
            = LinfNorm (fun s => BellmanOp P R γ (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁) s
                - BellmanOp P R γ (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀) s) := by
              simp [ChainFwd]
        _ ≤ γ * LinfNorm (fun s => |ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁ s
            - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀ s|) := by
                                                                   
                                                   
              have hdiff : ∀ s : Fin n,
                  BellmanOp P R γ (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁) s
                  - BellmanOp P R γ (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀) s
                  = γ * (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s' * (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁ s'
                      - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀ s')) := by
                intro s
                unfold BellmanOp
                                                           
                simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
              have hb := bellman_contraction P γ hγ0 hPnonneg hPsum
                (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁) (ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀)

name: value_iteration_converges
stmt:
theorem value_iteration_converges (P : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (R : Fin n → ℝ) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hPnonneg : ∀ s s', 0 ≤ P s s')
    (hPsum : ∀ s, (∑ s' : Fin n, P s s') = 1) (V₀ V₁ : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t : ℕ,
      LinfNorm (fun s => ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₁ s
        - ChainFwd (fun _ : ℕ => BellmanOp P R γ) t V₀ s) < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ LinfNorm (fun s => V₁ s - V₀ s) := linfNorm_nonneg _
                             
  rcases (geom_contraction_eventually γ (LinfNorm (fun s => V₁ s - V₀ s)) hγ0 hγ1 hM0 ε hε)
    with ⟨t, ht⟩
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (value_iteration_contraction P R γ hγ0 hγ1 hPnonneg hPsum V₀ V₁ t) ht

              
                                   
                                            
                                      
                                
                                

end Lattice
